**Why Kestrabel Ventures for your seed round**

Kestrabel Ventures is a London-based firm founded in 2012. It invests at Seed and Series A, and its two focus areas are cybersecurity and developer tools. For a UK cybersecurity startup raising seed, that is as close a fit as this dataset has. When I searched for seed-stage cybersecurity investors in the UK, Kestrabel was the only firm that came back. Its cheques run from €1M to €5M, so it can write a meaningful seed cheque and still have room to lead or follow on at Series A.

Two of its three portfolio companies are in security. Tarnwick Security, backed in 2020, provides managed detection for small law firms that have no in-house security staff. Rukvane Security runs a platform that helps mid-market companies with older identity systems roll out phishing-resistant passkeys. Kestrabel led a €3.5M seed round in Rukvane, announced on 15 April 2026, so it is still actively leading cybersecurity seed rounds. It also backed Glintmark Labs (2022), a tool that flags risky dependency upgrades before code is merged, which adds relevant software supply-chain knowledge. Founders get an investor that knows security buyers, can lead the round, and can stay in for Series A.

**Things to check before you send this:**
- **"Best" goes beyond the data.** Kestrabel is the only match in a 30-firm demo dataset. I have no information on how its companies have performed, so the pitch avoids claiming it is better than other investors.
- **The track record is small.** It's three companies in total, and only two are in security.
- **The Rukvane dates don't match.** The portfolio lists the investment in 2025, but the news item dates the seed round to April 2026.
- **Cheque size wasn't checked against a raise.** Tell me how much you're raising and I can check it against the €1M–€5M range.
